_meta.description: Stage 1 (Registered) for the Connected Planning Sales Foundations journey — the universal sales-track foundational journey required before any per-application Sales journey.
_meta._audience_note: Required for Sales persona. Replaces 'Anaplan Platform' as Sales' second prereq because sellers need value-messaging and Connected Planning narrative grounding rather than deep platform fluency.

_note: Stage 1 task structure for the Connected Planning Sales Foundations journey.
name: Registered
description: Sales-track resource confirms journey understanding, partner portal access, sales-resource profile, Partner Success engagement model, and Anaplan Overview prereq completion.

tasks.title: Review Connected Planning Sales Foundations roadmap & expectations
tasks.description: Walk through the 3 stages of the Sales Foundations journey, what's covered in each, and how this foundational journey routes to per-application Sales journeys (IFP Sales, FCR Sales, etc.) on completion.

tasks.title: Complete sales-resource profile
tasks.description: Augment the resource profile with sales-specialization fields: prior sales experience (years), prior products sold, primary customer segments (Enterprise / Mid-Market / SMB), industries covered, region/territory, and language coverage. Manager attestation required to exit Stage 2.

tasks.title: Understand how to engage Anaplan partner-sales support
tasks.description: Review the partner-sales support engagement model — channel manager / Partner Account Manager contact, deal-desk and pricing escalation path, pre-sales support request mechanism, competitive-intelligence support, and how to use the Partner Sales agent. Differs from the Partner Success / technical support paths used in foundational technical journeys.

gates.description: Connected Planning Sales Foundations roadmap reviewed and acknowledged

_stage_exit_actions_note: No system-side actions on Stage 1 exit. No sandbox provisioning — Sales Foundations Stage 3 mock pitch is conducted via the AI mock-pitch agent.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Lightweight Stage 1 — sales onboarding rather than technical onboarding.
